description: We are ORBY, a six-member team from CamTech University and AUPP in Cambodia, with skills in software engineering, AI, cybersecurity, research, and data analysis. For NASA Space Apps 2026, we are building the Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer, a browser-based game where students manage lunar resources, respond to emergencies, and see how decisions affect astronaut survival. We combine development, research, system design, and storytelling to make space science engaging through gameplay.
